![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_bfe0f7a2e3554ea69a23a13a547da106~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __Mette__

__Company Tea Kettle__

Enjoy a spot of tea in the comfort of your own C.A.M.P.!

- Collects Company Tea over time.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter. -

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4eb6b722db204ffb94b85c2f9b2fdb88~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Company Tea

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Jumpy Juice Company Tea Machine

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

5 pieces

**Obtainable via**

Season 15 Scoreboard - The Big Score - Free

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Cautious - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
